subject: domain, executor: attach stats collector for `IMPORT INTO` sessions (#61849)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent. importer.FlushTableStats now attaches a session stats collector (via statshandle.AttachStatsCollector) before StmtCommit/CommitTxn so updateStatsDeltaToCollector records IMPORT INTO row deltas even for internal sessions that otherwise lack a collector; bootstrap wires the hook and statistics/handle exports no-op defaults. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/consistency/concurrency issues found in executor/session/statistics paths, and upstream-master shows no later changes to these symbols.
